reading.body:
Tome is an AI presentation and storytelling tool, and the only product and MCP server in this dataset belong to that single focus: turning customer and narrative data into slides and sales intelligence.

The product record groups Tome under slides and presentations, but the description extends into narrative design and creative IP, which suggests the tool positions itself closer to strategic communication than to conventional slide software. The MCP server entry points toward a sales application, specifically using customer data to identify which accounts to prioritize. These two surfaces, creative storytelling and customer segmentation, share a common output: structured persuasion aimed at a business audience.

The data does not include revenue figures, employee counts, infrastructure details, or compute dependencies. Nothing here connects Tome to power consumption, data center footprint, or scaling constraints. The record covers what the product does, not how it is built or how large the operation is.
